name: Le Méridien Visconti Rome
positioning: Design hotel in Rome's Prati district with mid-century modern interiors, a few steps from St. Peter's and Piazza di Spagna
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Vatican, the Spanish Steps and the Tiber
Guests who want a suite with a private rooftop terrace and hot tub

facts.text: The hotel is in Rome's Prati district, a few steps from St. Peter's and Piazza di Spagna.
The hotel is a short walk from the Spanish Steps, the Vatican and the Tiber River.
The interior design, from the lighting to the furnishings, is a contemporary interpretation of mid-century modernism.
Roman architectural materials inspire the guest rooms and suites.
The Grand Suite lounge has a record player for listening to vinyl records.
The Top Suite terrace has an outdoor shower and a bar area.
Longitude 12 Bistrot & Jardin is a coffee house by day and a restaurant by evening, serving Italian flavors in an indoor garden setting.
Guests can rent e-bikes directly from the hotel to explore Rome.
The hotel holds Green Key certification.
The hotel has a complimentary fitness center.

highlights.text: Paparazzo Bar & Rooftop is a rooftop cocktail bar above the city, inspired by the glamour of the 1960s Dolce Vita.
The Top Suite has a large green terrace with a private hot tub and views of the city's rooftops and architecture.
The Grand Suite has a terrace with a private hot tub, where guests can watch the sun rise over Castel Sant'Angelo.
The Terrace Suites have a living room, a marble bathroom with a bathtub and separate shower, and a private terrace overlooking Rome's rooftops.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes the busy Prati neighborhood may feel hectic during peak tourist season.
